target_selection: Largest mean incoming elapsed gap among activities with at least100calibration transitions; potential observed delay, not proven bottleneck

assumptions.queue: FIFO shared abstract slots for selected activity; not inferred actual personnel
assumptions.disruption: Nonpreemptive capacity hold requested day30,released no earlier than45; active work is never interrupted. Late acquisition has shorter/no hold; actual replay records it.
assumptions.arrivals: Observed selected test-cohort starts; demand growth draws extra empirical starts. Not a population-wide demand forecast.
assumptions.common_random_numbers: Per-case,replicate,component seeds preserve unchanged original agents across scenarios; route modifications can alter later draw correspondence.

limits: All resource/service parameters are explicitly hypothetical; historical elapsed intervals cannot identify them.
These are model responses, not demonstrated organizational improvements or causal effects.
Change/Cancel intervention changes transition weights20percent then renormalizes; it does not guarantee20percent fewer repeats.
Arrival count grows30percent within the selected cohort; throughput levels cannot be extrapolated to the whole company.
No money, staff productivity or guaranteed savings are calculated.
Sensitivity design changes both assumed share and designed slots, rather than identifying a unique real capacity.
